comment: The fader's tooltip reads half the attenuation the code applies: the displayed dB is 20 times the log of the knob value while the gain applied is that value squared, so a tooltip of -6dB is really -12dB. The README says the solo hold is 1.5 seconds; the code counts 50 drag frames, which is nearer a second at 60 frames per second. Each strip's contribution is divided by 16 for the chain and multiplied by 16 again at the master.
